```{r}
library(haven)
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(ggthemes)
library(forcats)

school_safety <- read_sas("data/pu_ssocs18.sas7bdat")

```

## Row {height="70%"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total Incidents Recorded"

incidents_record <- school_safety |>
  summarise(incidents_record_sum = sum(INCID18)) |>
  pull(incidents_record_sum)

list(
  icon = "home",
  color = "danger",
  value = incidents_record
)

```
